opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year of audited or examined accounts.
opportunities.summary: Regular grants support operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activity projects for UK charities. Applications are accepted all year round with no deadline; funding typically around 10‑20% of an organisation's annual budget.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted under Charity Commission guidance; for major grants, organisations must have annual income over £1 million or project/capital costs over £1 million; must have at least one year of audited or examined accounts.
opportunities.summary: Major grants (£100,000 and over) are considered by trustees at eight board meetings per year and support capital, project or core cost grants for larger UK charities. Applications are accepted all year round with no deadline; funding typically 10‑20% of total project or capital costs.
